create_Augmenter: create an Augmenter module that applies geometric and video augmentations to watermarked images
build_augmenter_with_params: build an Augmenter with named augmentations, per-aug parameters, and mask embedder configuration
run_Augmenter_forward: run the Augmenter forward pass to apply random augmentations and return augmented images with mask targets
test_Augmenter_inference: test the Augmenter in inference mode to apply augmentations without watermark masking
summarize_get_dummy_augmenter: summarize the get_dummy_augmenter function that returns an identity-only Augmenter
